intro: Consumer-facing mobile security coverage across nine articles from April 12 to October 15, 2026, spans cryptocurrency, civil society, financial services, and government targets, with Canada, Brazil, France, the European Union, and global readers represented. Midnight Mimosa and NSO Group appear among the tracked threat actors, while CVE-2026-58704 stands out among the vulnerabilities discussed. The severity mix includes five high-severity items, two medium, and one critical, reflecting the range of issues documented across this tag.
